p: fowls of the heaven: Not that God was angry with these dumb creatures, but because man was so wicked for whose cause they were created, God makes them to take part of the punishments with him.
Chemarims with the priests: Who were an order of superstitious priests appointed to minister in the service of Baal, and were as his special chaplains; read 2Ki 23:5, Ho 10:5.

Malcham: He alludes to their idol Molech, which was forbidden; read Le 20:2, yet they called him their king, and made him as a god: therefore he here notes those that will both say they worship God, and yet will swear by idols and serve them: which faltering is here condemned, as in Eze 20:39, 1Ki 18:21, 2Ki 17:33.
strange apparel: Meaning, the courtiers, who did imitate the strange apparel of other nations to win their favour by it, and to appear glorious in the eyes of all others; read Eze 23:14-15.
leap on the threshold: He means the servants of the rulers who invade other men's houses, and rejoice and leap for joy, when they can get any gain to please their master with.
fish gate: Signifying that all the corners of the city of Jerusalem would be full of trouble.
Maktesh: This is meant of the street of the merchants which was lower than the rest of the place around it.
candles: So that nothing will escape me.
on their lees: By their prosperity they are hardened in their wickedness.
the mighty man shall cry there: They that trusted in their own strength and condemned the Prophets of God.
